name: Hesper AI
long_description:
Hesper AI builds AI agents that investigate P&C insurance claims end to end.

Hesper’s agents read the claim file, detect tampered documents, verify facts, check coverage, flag inconsistencies, and produce an audit-ready case file in minutes, so insurers can check every claim. 

We work with Claims and SIU orgs at Carriers, MGAs and TPAs,

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Previously Engineering Manager at Nanonets(YC W17), where he built Flow (Accounts Payable product) from scratch to $200K ARR and scaled the engineering team from 7 to 25. Earlier, first engineer on the Export-Import team at Shipsy, building the global container tracking and ETA prediction system from the ground up. 

Dual degree in Electronics & Economics from BITS Pilani.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio:
Nitish Badu is the Co-founder/COO of Hesper AI.

Previously, he scaled revenue at Nanonets (YC W17) to $4M in ARR, where he built out the GTM motion, outbound and partnerships. He has approximately 4 years of experience driving go-to-market and revenue for B2B AI companies.

Before that, he was GTM Lead at Super.AI. He holds a degree from BITS Pilani.
